My wife and I transferred from the Eaglescliffe Health Centre 18 months ago.  To date we have found the service at ALMA very efficient.
We all have to be realistic, this is not private medical care, you are not offered a free cappuccino but equally you don't get a £200 bill for a consultation either.
Too many people abuse the NHS system, they book an appointment and then fail to attend without having the courtesy to cancel the appointment which could be given to someone else.  People arrive late and still expect to be seen.  Pharmacies have expensive medications sat on their shelves which are never collected.
I have friends who live in other parts of the country and have listened to their comments about their GP practice, I can therefore assure you ALMA is excellent by comparison.
The NHS system and its dedicated staff should be treated with the respect they deserve.",null,[0,157]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2t4elFXODFlbkUwT1hCM1NtZGtkVTVTUnpoUk5YYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x3bc1daaaa406cbb9!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOkxzQW81enE0OXB3SmdkdU5SRzhRNXc%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2t4elFXODFlbkUwT1hCM1NtZGtkVTVTUnpoUk5YYxAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjulJq1tLCTAxXUL3sEHcuSJA0QoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjulJq1tLCTAxXUL3sEHcuSJA0Q0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMDVEYW14WUxWOWZSV2hEZHpOTlkwNWlUMDVXYmpkQlgxRlhhMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpTWTBOWk1FdFBWbVkwV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tSb1ltSXRObmxuZEc5NmRGOVlZMDUzZDFwUVYxRRAB",["0x0:0x3bc1daaaa406cbb9",null,1764673532348530,1764673532348530,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/116631767337882004115/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Brian Dixon","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXD9krfZIHPnYGGzfuEH7VEOcXZ2bXB45E9rjhOo86LxS3TkX5T=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/116631767337882004115?hl=en"],"116631767337882004115",null,2,0,null,[0,2,1],0,["2 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjulJq1tLCTAxXUL3sEHcuSJA0Q7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"3 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Absolutely apauling receptionist. a result of spending days simply trying to get through to the receptionist, (this was not a one-off), I've sadly decided to leave this practice, after many years.
My 3 stars reflect the fact that I have no complaints about the doctors, medical staff or even the receptionists.
However the mechanisms for getting an appointment are sadly lacking.
So yesterday, I contacted another practice!
I got through on the telephone swiftly, was regularly informed of my position in the cue, and spoke to a receptionist within a few minutes. This is in stark contrast to getting a constant busy message for nearly 6 days (2 of these were the weekend) and then eventually when I did get through, being left in a cue for around 30 minutes, with no indication as to my position in that cue.
Previous attempts to book appointments have been equally arduous and frustrating.
This is in contrast to my new surgery where I was registered within hours of submitting my transfer request!
I then phoned the following morning, explained my needs and was phoned back with 90 minutes and an appointment was arranged.
I arrived on time and was seen swiftly.
This just goes to prove that it is possible to run a surgery where getting an appointment does not feel like playing the lottery while moving through a mine field.
I hope that Alma Street will review their booking practices and improve the experience because, as has been proven, it is possible and would greatly improve the patient experience.
In fairness, before COVID I would have rated them excellent, but this appears to be still being used as an excuse for the poor front end service they now provide.
I hope improvements are made as the decidated staff should not have their efforts compromised by a failed booking system, not to mention that your patients deserve better.",null,[0,165]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21kWWJrOVlTa05XTkVJNWJtcFZPVlpKTFRoaGJrRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x3bc1daaaa406cbb9!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOmdYbk9YSkNWNEI5bmpVOVZJLThhbkE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21kWWJrOVlTa05XTkVJNWJtcFZPVlpKTFRoaGJrRRAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjulJq1tLCTAxXUL3sEHcuSJA0QoykIECgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjulJq1tLCTAxXUL3sEHcuSJA0Q0pMFCA4oBA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMXBzVVhsemNsOWZSV2hCU2toVFFrSkROVzlXWnpCUmFITkljMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpUVVVOYWJWWkVTM2x6V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pOYVUxQldVMGxzZEhod1NGbENjWEpWTW1oVlJYYxAB",["0x0:0x3bc1daaaa406cbb9",null,1754862102514216,1754862102514216,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/104498365625229557879/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["catherine miller","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXWb6YheBTzU7xaTudkjKu1ByN9USFVNit0T9Mtb1V5mZP9xjmoBA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/104498365625229557879?hl=en"],"104498365625229557879",null,24,59,null,[1,5,1],14,["Local Guide · 24 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjulJq1tLCTAxXUL3sEHcuSJA0Q7LoGCBIoAA"]]]],null,"7 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[3],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Too long to wait for doctor, always.
